items: The shipment was delayed ____ severe weather closed the mountain pass overnight.
'Because' introduces the reason the shipment was delayed.
____ the software update was completed on time, several users still reported login problems.
'Although' introduces a contrast between the timely update and the continuing login problems.
The training session was recorded ____ employees in other offices could watch it later.
'So that' introduces the purpose of recording the training session.
The supplier will not release the order ____ the purchasing department confirms the revised quantity.
'Unless' means 'if not' and states the condition required before the supplier will release the order.
____ the downtown branch focuses on retail clients, the airport branch mainly serves corporate travelers.
'While' appropriately contrasts the two branches' different customer groups.
____ the audit identified several missing receipts, the accounting team requested additional documentation.
'Since' introduces the reason the accounting team requested more documentation.
The conference room can be reserved for Friday ____ no executive meeting is scheduled at that time.
'If' introduces the condition under which the room can be reserved.
The domestic sales team exceeded its target, ____ the overseas division finished slightly below forecast.
'Whereas' contrasts the performance of the two divisions.
____ the technician replaced the damaged cable, the network connection became stable again.
'After' correctly shows that the network stabilized following the cable replacement.
Please review the expense report ____ you submit it to the finance director.
'Before' correctly orders the review ahead of the submission.
____ the new warehouse opens, all regional deliveries will be routed through that facility.
'Once' means 'as soon as/when' and marks the future point after which routing will change.
The help desk logs each incident ____ a customer reports a recurring technical problem.
'Whenever' expresses that the logging action occurs each time the stated event happens.
You may use the company vehicle ____ you return it to the garage by 8 p.m.
'As long as' states the condition that must be satisfied for permission to use the vehicle.
____ demand for the product remained strong, the manufacturer postponed its planned expansion.
'Even though' introduces the unexpected contrast between strong demand and the postponed expansion.
The manager approved temporary staff ____ three regular employees will be attending an off-site conference next week.
'Because' gives the reason temporary staff were approved.
The company added a second inspection step ____ defective parts would be detected before shipment.
'So that' introduces the purpose of adding the second inspection step.
____ the client requests a different date, the installation team will arrive on September 8 as scheduled.
'Unless' means the scheduled date remains in effect except if the client requests another date.
____ the first proposal emphasized cost reduction, the revised version focuses on service quality.
'While' contrasts the emphasis of the two proposals.
Employees may collect their new security cards ____ the orientation session ends.
'After' correctly shows that card collection follows the orientation session.
The legal team must approve the final wording ____ the contract is sent to the customer for signature.
'Before' correctly places legal approval earlier than sending the contract for signature.
____ the replacement parts arrive by Thursday, the repair crew can finish the work before the weekend.
'If' introduces the condition that would allow the crew to finish before the weekend.
____ online orders increased sharply, sales at the company's physical stores remained almost unchanged.
'Whereas' highlights the contrast between rising online orders and nearly unchanged store sales.
____ the conference organizer expects more than 300 guests, an additional registration desk will be opened.
'Since' introduces the reason an additional registration desk will be opened.
The revised pricing policy will take effect ____ all regional managers have received the implementation guide.
'Once' indicates that the policy will take effect after the stated prerequisite has been completed.
____ the new printer is more expensive than the previous model, it uses substantially less ink.
'Although' introduces the contrast between the higher purchase price and lower ink consumption.
